description: Robustness of the GES-hydrophobicity rule: FDR correction over 16 parameters, exclusion of the self-referential Mim1 case, leave-one-out threshold stability, and predictions for contested/untested anchors, with figures
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, math, json
from scipy import stats
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

F=pd.read_csv("mim_anchor_features.csv"); R=pd.read_csv("mim_param_stats_all.csv")
rej,padj,_,_=multipletests(R.MWU_p.values,method='fdr_bh')
R["p_FDR"]=padj
print("FDR-corrected across 16 parameters:")
print(R[["param","sep","MWU_p","p_FDR"]].round(4).to_string(index=False))

# --- drop the self-referential Mim1 (it IS the insertase subunit) ---
G=F[F.mim_class.isin(["dependent","independent"]) & (F.gene!="Mim1")]
dep=G[G.mim_class=="dependent"]; ind=G[G.mim_class=="independent"]
def auroc(a,b):
    return np.mean([[1.0 if y>x else (0.5 if y==x else 0.0) for y in b] for x in a])
print("\n=== Excluding Mim1 (self-reference): dependent n=%d vs independent n=%d (Tom22, Fis1) ==="%(len(dep),len(ind)))
rows=[]
for p in ["GES","KD","Eisenberg","Hessa_dG_sum","WW_oct","muH","GlyPro","anchor_len","flank_sum"]:
    A=auroc(dep[p].values,ind[p].values); U,pv=stats.mannwhitneyu(ind[p].values,dep[p].values,alternative='two-sided')
    rows.append(dict(param=p,AUROC=A,sep=max(A,1-A),p=pv))
print(pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("sep",ascending=False).round(4).to_string(index=False))
print("Minimum attainable two-sided p, n=10 vs n=2:", 2/math.comb(12,2))

# --- leave-one-out threshold stability on GES (full 13-protein set) ---
V=F[F.mim_class.isin(["dependent","independent"])][["gene","GES","mim_class"]].reset_index(drop=True)
def fit_thr(sub):
    c=sorted(sub.GES.values); best=(-1,None)
    for i in range(len(c)-1):
        t=(c[i]+c[i+1])/2
        pr=np.where(sub.GES.values>t,"independent","dependent")
        tp=((pr=="dependent")&(sub.mim_class=="dependent")).sum()/ (sub.mim_class=="dependent").sum()
        tn=((pr=="independent")&(sub.mim_class=="independent")).sum()/ max((sub.mim_class=="independent").sum(),1)
        ba=0.5*(tp+tn)
        if ba>best[0]: best=(ba,t)
    return best
loo=[]
for i in range(len(V)):
    tr=V.drop(i); te=V.loc[i]
    ba,t=fit_thr(tr)
    pred="independent" if te.GES>t else "dependent"
    loo.append(dict(gene=te.gene,true=te.mim_class,thr=round(t,3),pred=pred,correct=pred==te.mim_class))
L=pd.DataFrame(loo)
print("\n=== Leave-one-out validation of the GES threshold rule ===")
print(L.to_string(index=False))
print("LOO accuracy = %.3f (%d/%d); LOO balanced accuracy = %.3f"%(
    L.correct.mean(), L.correct.sum(), len(L),
    0.5*(L[L.true=="dependent"].correct.mean()+L[L.true=="independent"].correct.mean())))

# --- apply rule to contested / untested ---
THR=1.53
P=F[~F.mim_class.isin(["dependent","independent"])][["gene","topology","mim_class","GES","Hessa_dG_sum","anchor"]].copy()
P["predicted"]=np.where(P.GES>THR,"MIM-independent (spontaneous/other)","MIM-dependent")
print("\n=== Rule applied to contested / untested anchors (GES threshold 1.53) ===")
print(P.round(3).to_string(index=False))

# ---------- FIGURES ----------
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16,5.2))
col={"dependent":"#c0392b","independent":"#2471a3","contested":"#b8860b","untested":"#7f8c8d","inferred":"#7f8c8d"}
ax=axes[0]
order=F.sort_values("GES")
for i,(_,r) in enumerate(order.iterrows()):
    ax.scatter(r.GES,i,color=col.get(r.mim_class,"#999"),s=90,zorder=3)
    ax.text(r.GES+0.05,i,r.gene,va="center",fontsize=9)
ax.axvline(THR,ls="--",c="k",lw=1)
ax.text(THR+0.03,-0.9,"threshold 1.53",fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlabel("mean GES hydrophobicity of membrane anchor (kcal/mol per residue)")
ax.set_title("Anchor hydrophobicity ranks MIM-dependent below MIM-independent")
ax.set_xlim(-0.2,2.8)
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
ax.legend(handles=[Line2D([],[],marker='o',ls='',color=v,label=k) for k,v in col.items() if k in set(F.mim_class)],fontsize=8,loc="lower right")

ax=axes[1]
d=F[F.mim_class=="dependent"].GES; i_=F[F.mim_class=="independent"].GES
ax.boxplot([d,i_],labels=["MIM-dependent\n(n=10)","MIM-independent\n(n=3)"],widths=0.5)
ax.scatter(np.random.default_rng(1).normal(1,0.05,len(d)),d,color=col["dependent"],zorder=3)
ax.scatter(np.random.default_rng(2).normal(2,0.05,len(i_)),i_,color=col["independent"],zorder=3)
for g,v in zip(F[F.mim_class=="independent"].gene,i_): ax.text(2.08,v,g,fontsize=8,va="center")
for g,v in zip(F[F.mim_class=="dependent"].gene,d):
    if v>1.5: ax.text(1.08,v,g,fontsize=8,va="center")
ax.set_ylabel("mean GES hydrophobicity"); ax.set_title("AUROC 0.93, exact Mann-Whitney p=0.028,\nFDR over 16 parameters p=0.45")

ax=axes[2]
for _,r in F.iterrows():
    ax.scatter(r.GES,r.Hessa_dG_sum,color=col.get(r.mim_class,"#999"),s=80,zorder=3)
    ax.text(r.GES+0.03,r.Hessa_dG_sum+0.1,r.gene,fontsize=8)
ax.axvline(THR,ls="--",c="k",lw=1); ax.axhline(0,ls=":",c="grey",lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel("mean GES hydrophobicity"); ax.set_ylabel("Hessa dG_app sum (kcal/mol), lower = inserts unaided")
ax.set_title("Two insertion-energy proxies agree:\nMIM clients have the least insertion-competent anchors")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
